headline: Wealthy Chinese, tech talent confront tighter borders as Beijing widens exit controls
detail: This signals increasing capital controls and potentially a brain drain from China. It could hurt Chinese tech companies and global tech firms reliant on Chinese talent/market. This is negative for tech sentiment.
rec: Consider trimming QQQ/SMH exposure due to broader tech market impact from China's policies.

headline: Morgan Stanley joins Goldman Sachs in 11th-hour switch to forecasting a Fed hike
detail: Major banks now expect a Fed hike, increasing interest rate pressure. Higher rates hurt growth stocks and make margin more expensive, amplifying drawdowns for your tech-heavy, margin-funded portfolio.
rec: Review your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) and consider trimming broader tech (QQQ, SMH) to reduce rate sensitivity.

headline: 10-year Treasury yield rises to highest since 2007 as Fed rate-hike expectations rise
detail: Rising yields make future earnings of growth stocks less valuable and increase borrowing costs. This is a direct headwind for your tech/chip heavy portfolio, especially on margin.
rec: This reinforces the need to reduce exposure to rate-sensitive tech/chip names. Consider trimming QQQ, SMH.

headline: China's August retail sales miss forecast while investment slump deepens, piling pressure on Beijing
detail: Weak Chinese economic data indicates slowing demand, which directly impacts global tech and chip companies that rely on the Chinese market for sales. This adds to the bearish outlook for your portfolio.
rec: This further supports trimming tech/chip exposure (QQQ, SMH) given the significant market reliance on China.
